about: Agent host profiles for the site's host preview and host matrix. Every preview on the site is a simulation: the kit draws the host's skin and plays its bridge in this page. `tier` is what the host's public source or docs declare (tiers as in integration/surfaces.json). `receipt` points at an existing native receipt, or is null when nobody has run the kit inside that host.

tiers.0: Shown through the host's existing HTML/artifact surface. No channel back to the chat.
tiers.1: Context back: the host takes what you pick in the card into the chat or the model's context.
tiers.2: Native catalog component: the host draws the card itself and owns its intents.

fixture.why: makeCard(app, kind) seeds rng(app + kind), so every frame draws the same card

hosts.label: T3 Code
hosts.surface: Inline app card under the tool row in a web or desktop thread

tier.how: OpenUI app-card catalog on the fork's nightly channel (experiment/openui-app-cards); html_render for exports (512 KB cap)

receipt.note: Native for everyday app cards on the fork nightly only; intent, intel and trace kinds are not in the native catalog.

hosts.label: Hermes desktop
hosts.surface: Artifact card: iframe sandbox=allow-scripts srcdoc, or a cards.html file preview row

tier.how: Self-contained export in the artifact frame; no postMessage channel back to chat yet

bridge.label: no channel
bridge.carries: nothing; the intent stays in the card

hosts.receiptNote: Frame contract checked in Chromium with tools/desktop-frame-harness.mjs, not in a running desktop build.

hosts.label: Tern · Glide
hosts.vendor: kvnloo/glide (Hermes plugin drawing in Tern; formerly hermes-tern)
hosts.surface: A closed ```ephemeral-ui fence in the answer, drawn as a live card by Glide's Tern frontend (frontend/src/eui)

tier.how: Glide's frontend renders the pinned kit inline; card controls send intents to the host (EuiHost publishKit/publishNative)

bridge.label: host intent callback
bridge.carries: UiIntent to Glide's host under the card's revision

receipt.note: Tier 0, 1 and 2 recorded there on 2026-11-03; not through the live /visual discovery path.

hosts.label: ChatGPT
hosts.surface: MCP Apps view: a ui:// resource (text/html;profile=mcp-app) in a sandboxed iframe beside the conversation; inline, fullscreen or pip

tier.how: MCP Apps bridge (JSON-RPC over postMessage): ui/update-model-context and ui/message carry a pick back; window.openai holds ChatGPT-only extras

bridge.label: MCP Apps ui/update-model-context
bridge.carries: the pick as structuredContent for the model's next turn

hosts.label: Codex
hosts.surface: MCP Apps view inline in a Codex desktop thread (inline and fullscreen; pip requests answer fullscreen). The CLI and IDE extension show the tool result as text.

tier.how: Same MCP Apps bridge as ChatGPT in the desktop app; text-only (no card) in the CLI

bridge.label: MCP Apps ui/update-model-context
bridge.carries: the pick as structuredContent for the model's next turn

hosts.textOnly: Codex CLI / IDE: the card's text summary only

hosts.label: Claude
hosts.surface: MCP App (interactive connector) inline in the conversation on web, desktop and mobile; side panel or fullscreen where offered

tier.how: MCP Apps bridge: ui/update-model-context for picks, ui/message for asks; Claude asks permission before showing the app. Claude Code shows the tool result as text.

bridge.label: MCP Apps ui/update-model-context
bridge.carries: the pick as structuredContent for the model's next turn

hosts.textOnly: Claude Code: the card's text summary only

hosts.label: o8
hosts.surface: o8_html_render visualization in the workspace transcript: sandbox=allow-scripts frame, no network (connect-src 'none'), 512 KiB cap, live theme variables

tier.how: The frame posts o8-visualization:question; o8 shows it as a proposal and the user's Add to chat puts it in the draft. o8-visualization:state stays presentation-only.

bridge.label: o8-visualization:question
bridge.carries: a proposed question the user adds to chat
